name: TensorPM v1.45.0
body:
# Changelog - v1.45.0

This release is mostly about reliability. It fixes a long list of defects in sync, tasks,
budget, mail and the AI chat, hardens updates and encryption keys, and makes the first steps
in a new project clearer. The app texts in German and English were revised throughout.

## 🎉 New Features

### A clearer start for new projects

- **One next step:** the overview of a project that already has content now leads with a single
  action: plan the first tasks when AI is available, otherwise open the project.
- **Your name is taken as typed:** a plain name entered in the onboarding chat is used directly
  instead of being sent to the AI. That is faster and can no longer fail.
- **An honest loading screen:** while a project is generated, TensorPM says what it is preparing
  and how long that usually takes, and notifies you when the project is ready if the window is
  in the background.

### Revised texts

- **New headline:** "Manage less. Achieve more." ("Weniger verwalten. Mehr erreichen.")
- **All app texts reviewed in German and English:** 826 texts were corrected or simplified.
  Among them were wrong statements, such as plan texts that named Pro where a free account is
  enough, a tooltip for table columns that do not exist, and "step 11 of 10".

## 🔒 Security

- **Updates are checked for our signature:** before TensorPM installs an update on Windows, it
  now verifies that the downloaded installer was signed by TensorPM and has not been changed
  since. Until now an update was accepted when its checksum matched the one announced by the
  update server. The check runs inside TensorPM and starts no other program.
- **Additional checks before a release goes out:** every release is now tested a second time,
  independently of the machine it was prepared on, before it is published and offered as an
  update.
- **The AI agent cannot approve its own skills:** the agent's file tools no longer reach the
  folder in which TensorPM records which skills you approved.
- **Synced folder names stay inside the project folder:** a project or workspace folder name
  received through sync is only accepted if it is a plain folder name.
- **Encryption keys are backed up safely:** signing in with a password on a device that already
  had a key file could replace the key backup on the server with an incomplete one. TensorPM
  now merges the keys of the device with the backup instead of replacing it.
- **Keys stay with their account:** after signing out and signing in with another account on
  the same device, the keys of the first account could end up in the key file of the second.
  Keys are now released on sign-out and only saved for the account they were loaded for.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### Sync and teamwork

- **Changes by teammates are no longer overwritten:** when a synced change arrived, only the
  open project was reloaded. Another loaded project kept its old copy, and its next save could
  reopen a task a teammate had completed or bring back a deleted one. All loaded projects are
  now reloaded.
- **Startup with incomplete synced material data:** an older database migration failed when a
  material item pointed to a category, file or parent item that no longer existed, and
  TensorPM then did not start. The migration now completes.

### Tasks and planning

- **Priority board with "hide completed":** dragging a card, dropping it into another column or
  adding one with "+" placed it at the wrong position or moved a different card.
- **Recurring tasks:** recurring tasks were only created for the workspace that was active at
  the first check of the day. Projects in other workspaces, or created later that day, now get
  theirs too.
- **Scheduled follow-ups:** a scheduled AI follow-up could run several times when the answer
  took longer than a minute. It now runs once, and a follow-up set to start a new chat does so
  even if the main window was closed when it came due.
- **Pasted dates:** a date pasted into a date field is now read in the order the field shows.
  A year-month-day date such as 2026-11-04 is understood in every language setting, and a date
  with a two-digit year is no longer saved with a wrong year.

### Budget

- **Typed amounts are shown as typed:** with automatic exchange rates and a display currency
  other than the storage currency, 1,000 USD typed could be shown as 931.62 USD.
- **Material summary:** collapsing a group no longer removes its items from the totals, and a
  group with its own amount is no longer counted twice.
- **Sorting by effort** compares durations, so 3 days rank above 10 hours.
- **Spending chart and overrun check** use your local day instead of the UTC day.
- **Generated projects:** a budget extracted by the AI is converted into the storage currency
  you configured instead of always into EUR.
- **Invalid amounts from the AI are refused:** an amount the AI sent in an unusable form was
  stored as 0 and overwrote the budget. It is now rejected with an error.

### Mail

- **Microsoft 365:** a project added to an existing connector, a longer lookback or a manual
  sync now actually reads the configured period again. Reply drafts for unrelated mails are
  also no longer treated as one conversation, where the second replaced the first one's
  pending approval.
- **IMAP:** on servers whose day starts after UTC, mails received around midnight could be
  skipped.

### AI chat

- **No invented tool calls with OpenAI and local models:** example code in an answer could be
  mistaken for a tool call and executed, and the text was cut out of the answer.
- **Stop during a tool run:** after stopping the AI in the middle of a tool run, the unfinished
  tool call was sent along with every later message on Trial and Pro accounts. It is now left
  out, as it already was with your own API keys.
- **Distiller:** a cancelled or timed-out change is no longer recorded as applied, and "Attach"
  on a dependency card works.

### Agents and integrations

- **Sign-in for remote MCP servers** completes instead of ending with "No PKCE code verifier
  stored".
- **Continue.dev:** the one-click setup writes the configuration Continue expects and no longer
  breaks a file that already lists other MCP servers.
- **A2A:** continuing a chat that was started in the desktop app continues that chat instead of
  creating a new empty one.

### Files, skills and documents

- **Skills:** a changed input or output schema of a skill takes effect immediately, without a
  restart.
- **Folders with "$" in the name** are renamed and moved correctly, and a file that is deleted
  and immediately saved again with the same content stays active.
- **PDF preview in dark mode:** the full-page preview of an artifact no longer shows a thin
  dark edge.

## 📝 Notes

- No action needed. The update installs like any other.
- The signature check starts with this version: it applies to every update you receive after
  1.45.0.
- On the onboarding overview, "Cancel" is only offered while the setup is still empty, because
  it deletes the project. A project with content can be deleted in the project explorer.
- External agents that use A2A no longer see the Distiller's review chat in the list of
  conversations, because a message sent there would count as the review decision.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.45.0
- **Release Date**: 2026-11-12
- **Previous Version**: 1.44.3
- **Type**: Minor Release
